items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 76:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the bride of Moses? The Nukva of ZA is called the bride of Moses, and it is only from that aspect in which she is called the lower Hochma, namely at the time that through her the upper Hochma is revealed. For Moses is the Yesod of Aba, revealed from the chest of ZA and below, and the Nukva is not fit to draw the aspect of Hochma before she receives the illumination of the Yesod of Aba, in the secret of "Aba founded the daughter"; therefore, in this aspect she is called the bride of Moses. (Item 73).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 77:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the entry of the Creator into the Garden of Eden? The Keter of Rachel, which returns her nine Sefirot to their degree at midnight, upon which nine are attached the bodies of the souls of the righteous, which are thereby brought out from within the Klipot to holiness, is discerned as the entry of the Creator into the Garden of Eden, to delight with the souls of the righteous. For the Keter is the Creator, and the connection with his nine Sefirot, which are in Beriah, is discerned as an entry into the Garden of Eden, for the Garden of Eden is Beriah. And He delights there with the souls that were returned to holiness, as above. (Item 42).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 78:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the bowing of the head downward? The descent of the mouth of AA from its place, which is in the mouth of Atik, to the mouth of his KHB, in order to couple and give Mochin to Aba and Ima standing there, is discerned as the bowing of the head downward. See above in Answer 72 and below. (Item 193).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 79:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the bowing of the head in the aspect of the Mazal VeNakeh? There are three states in AA: one, in his ordinary manner, namely in his state of permanence, when his head is completely upright, namely that the lower ones have no grip in his head, except in his HGT alone. State two, when he couples to give the Mochin of AB to Aba and Ima, when his HGT become KHB, and Aba and Ima are found rising to the KHB as well, but AA himself is found at the time of this ascent in the GAR of Atik, and then he bows his head, which is in the place of Atik, and descends to the place where Aba and Ima stand, namely in his new KHB, and then he couples there upon the two Mazalot VeNotzer and VeNakeh and gives Mochin to Aba and Ima. State three is when he couples to give new Mochin and NHY to ZA, when he does not descend to the place of his new KHB, but makes the coupling in his place, in the place of the GAR of Atik; however, he does not make the coupling upon the MAN of his essence, but upon the MAN of the Mazal VeNakeh, since the aspect of his own Hochma cannot be bestowed to the lower ones, because of the membrane that covers the Mocha Stima'ah, and only the aspect of the Hochma that is revealed upon the MAN of the hairs does he bestow to the lower ones. Therefore he bows his head to the Mazal VeNakeh, upon whose MAN he bestows the Mochin of AB to ZA. And this state is discerned as the aspect of "neither upright nor bowed," for he is not bowed downward, namely in the place of his new KHB like with Aba and Ima, but makes the coupling in his place, in the GAR of Atik, and it is because ZA is the aspect of the NHY of Keter from his root, for he is from the root of the NHY of the inner AK, which bestowed the Vav and the point to the Aba and Ima of the Nekudim; therefore even in Atzilut he is drawn from the coupling of AA that is in the place of Atik, where the stature of Keter is, and therefore AA does not bow his head downward as with Aba and Ima, who have no grip except in the stature of AB. Therefore this coupling is discerned as not bowed. However, since he does not couple upon the MAN of his own aspect, but in the MAN of the Mazal VeNakeh, as above, therefore it is discerned as not upright, for he lowers the aspect of his coupling to the aspect of the Hochma of the thirty-two paths that come out upon the MAN of the hairs, which is much lower than the aspect of his own Hochma, which is the direct light, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 80:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the enlargement of Leah and the diminution of Rachel? At midnight, through the Mochin of the upper AB SAG, drawn to ZA and Leah, which lower the bottom Hey from the eyes to the mouth, when the HGT ascend to KHB, and the NHY to HGT, it is found that Leah, whose ending of her legs was at the point of the chest that was before, now descends to the end of the Yesod of ZA, since the NHY of ZA became HGT; behold, the point of the chest descended to the place of the Yesod, and her legs with them, for these NHY became HGT, which is the place of Leah. And likewise the Keter of Rachel, which is also at the point of the chest, is now found that the Keter of Rachel descended to the end of the Yesod of ZA, which is the end of Atzilut, and the nine Sefirot of Rachel, which were drawn and clothed upon the NHY of ZA as before, are now taken by Leah for her share, for now they became HGT, which are the share of Leah and not of Rachel. Now, all this change comes through the entry of the Mochin of Ima, which are from the illumination of the upper AB SAG, which lower the bottom Hey from the eyes to the mouth, as above. Therefore it is discerned that with the entry of these Mochin, "Leah is enlarged and Rachel is lowered," since the Mochin raise the NHY, which are Rachel's share, to the aspect of HGT, which are Leah's share. Behold, it is found that to the measure of the entry of the Mochin, Leah is enlarged, and to the measure of Leah's taking from the NHY, so is Rachel's descent to Beriah, to the place of the new NHY that Rachel receives there through these Mochin. For to the measure of the NHY that ascend to become HGT, so is the measure of the connection of the new NHY from Beriah, which afterward, during the day, when Rachel ascends to Atzilut, she raises with her these new NHY from Beriah to Atzilut. (Item 35).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 81:1
items.html: (To the question) What is "neither upright nor bowed"? Explained above, Item 79.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 82:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the source of the well? The Yesod of the Nukva is called a well, in the secret of the verse "the well which the princes dug, etc." And a source [Mabua] means: a spring, which is the Yesod of the male, which is the source of the ten Sefirot of the direct light, from which they are bestowed to the well of the Nukva. (Item 64).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 83:1
items.html: (To the question) What are sources and streams? The Yesod of the male is called a source, which is the source of the influx, and the aspect of the direct light. And the Yesod of the upper Nukva is called a stream, in the verse "he will drink from the stream by the way, therefore he will raise his head," and as the Rav explained, that all the Mochin of ZA come from the power that he receives from the Yesod of Ima, called the stream. Therefore the illuminations drawn from the Yesod of Aba to ZA are called sources, and the illuminations drawn from the Yesod of Ima are called streams. (Item 62).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 84:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the Mochin of birth? The Mochin of Hochma, called the light of Chayah, which ZA receives from Aba and Ima in the stature of AB, are the Mochin of birth, through which he gives birth to the GAR of souls. However, when he does not have these Mochin of the light of Chayah, ZA is not fit to give birth to the GAR of souls, for the aspect of essence is not drawn except from the light of Hochma. (Item 4).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 85:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Mazal? The Yesod is called Mazal, because it bestows the illumination of Hochma in the aspect of a path to pass through it, and the measure of Hochma in this aspect is estimated like a drop, meaning that there is no continuation in it, and it is the secret of the seminal drop of the light of Chayah. Therefore it is called Mazal, for its bestowal, which comes only in the measure of drop by drop, as above. (Item 83).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 86:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the constellations? Explained above in Answer 67.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 87:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Mazal VeNotzer? The eighth correction of the thirteen corrections of the beard is called Mazal VeNotzer Chesed [the Mazal and Keeper of mercy], for so it is called in the thirteen attributes of mercy in the Torah, as above in Part 13. And it includes all the twelve corrections of the beard of AA, and is discerned as the aspect of the Tifferet of the beard. For the hairs of the head are the GAR, and the hairs of the beard are their ZAT, as above in Part 13. Therefore, just as the Tifferet includes all the VAK, so the Mazal VeNotzer includes all the beard from the aspect of its five Hassadim. And the Mazal VeNakeh, which is the thirteenth correction, includes all the beard from the aspect of its five Gevurot. And it was already explained that the aspect of the Tifferet is the principal bearer of the illumination of Hochma, and the aspect of the Mazal VeNakeh, which is the Yesod of the beard, is only a bearer for the measure of the screens, upon which the coupling is made to raise the returning light.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 88:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Mazal VeNakeh? Explained above, Answer 87.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 89:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the filling of the beard? When ZA is in the aspect of VAK, he has six corrections of the beard, and when he has a complete ten Sefirot, which are from the aspect of the TZADIK of the Tzelem, namely at thirteen years and one day, he has nine corrections. And when he acquires the LAMED-MEM of the Makifim of Aba, namely at twenty years, he is completed with thirteen corrections like AA, and then it is discerned that his beard was filled. (Item 203).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 90:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Malchut of Ima that is not included in the Mochin of ZA? In these Mochin of AB that ZA receives from the Aba and Ima of AB, which come out upon the MAN of the Mazalot, the Nukva has no share in them, but they belong to ZA alone. And the Mochin of the Nukva begin to come out in the head of ZA, and there is the beginning of their coming out, and they have no grip in the essence of the Mochin of ZA, but they come out there upon a new coupling made in the aspect of the Malchut of Ima, which was not included in the Mochin of ZA, and not upon the aspect of the crown of Gevura of the Mochin of ZA himself.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 91:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the source of the well? The aspect of Benjamin in the Yesod of the Nukva, namely the aspect of the screen that raises the MAN to clothe the ten Sefirot of the direct light, which the Nukva acquires in her new NHY of greatness, is discerned as "the source of the well that never separates from the well." For it is all the degree of the Nukva, which raises the returning light upon the direct light, and therefore she also takes in its measure from the aspect of the ten Sefirot of the direct light, as is known. And just as the aspect of Joseph is the source for the aspect of the direct light drawn in the male, so the aspect of Benjamin is the source for the returning light that is attached to the Nukva. (Item 71).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 92:1
items.html: (To the question) What is a returning Makif? There are two kinds of Makifim: one is a Makif that was never in the aspect of an inner light, namely that it was not clothed in inner vessels, in the manner of the Makifim of the LAMED-MEM of the Tzelem of ZA. And there is an aspect of a Makif that comes in inner vessels at the time of the coming out of the Mochin, except that it returns and comes out at the time of the coming of the Mochin to their place, and they are the GAR of the revealed AB, that at the time of the coming out of the Mochin, the garments of the three aspects of MEM-LAMED-TZADIK are not there, and the GAR of the AB are revealed there. However, at the time of the birth of the Mochin, the GAR of the Mochin return to be clothed in the MEM of the Tzelem, which are covered Hassadim, and the GAR are compelled to depart from there to the aspect of Makifim. And so it operates always in these Mochin of the AB, and therefore those Makifim are discerned as the aspect of a returning Makif, for always at the time of birth it returns and becomes hidden from the inner vessels and becomes a Makif above them. See above, Answer 8. (Item 204).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 93:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the including Makifim of the LAMED-MEM of ZA? It is known that all the Mochin in all the degrees are divided into three aspects: MEM-LAMED-TZADIK, which are: KHB, HGT, NHY, discerned as: Hochma, Bina, Daat. Also: Aba and Ima, YESHSUT and ZON. However, there are three aspects of MEM-LAMED-TZADIK that include all the measure of the Mochin that ZA is able to attain, which are the measure of the stature of the Mochin of AB from the aspect of the place of their coming out in the upper Aba and Ima, at the time they rose to the GAR of AA, for all the measure of those Mochin belongs to ZA. Whereby the aspect of those Mochin in the place of their coming out in Aba and Ima, which are in the place of the GAR of AA, are the aspect of the MEM of these Mochin, and are the aspect of the Hochma of the Mochin, since they are in the place of AA, which is the stature of AB and Hochma. And the aspect of those Mochin after they expanded to the NHY of Aba and Ima, which are in the place of the two shoulders of AA at the time of the coupling, and where the upper Aba and Ima stand at the time of permanence, there is the aspect of the LAMED of the Mochin, which are the HGT of AA, and they are the stature of the Bina of the permanent Aba and Ima. And the aspect of the coming of the Mochin to ZA, who clothes upon the NHY of AA, is discerned as the TZADIK of these Mochin, which are the aspect of the NHY and the aspect of Daat, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 94:1
items.html: (To the question) What is "enslaved to Hesed and Gevura"? The aspect of the revealed Hassadim that ZA receives from the two crowns of Aba and Ima does not make him a completely free man, since he is enslaved to the coupling of Hesed and Gevura, which draw the illumination of Hochma, and then the external ones have no grip in his revealed NHY. However, without this coupling, there is fear of the external ones, that they will grip his NHY, as is known. However, the aspect of the KHB that ZA receives from the inheritance of Aba and Ima makes him a completely free man, for even without the coupling of Hesed and Gevura, the external ones have no grip in these lights, for they are corrected in the MEM of the Tzelem, in which no judgment and restriction has any grip, being the aspect of the GAR of Bina, as is known. (Item 60).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 95:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Nehiru [radiance]? Nehiru means the direct light. And Netzitzu [spark] means the returning light. (Item 74).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 96:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the radiance and the spark of the river that comes out of Eden? It is known that the Chochma Stima'ah of AA was corrected in the Nukva, and it took Bina out from the head, to the aspect of the throat and the HGT. And the Yesod of the Chochma Stima'ah, in which is its screen of the Nukva, namely the aspect of Benjamin included in Joseph, is found to take Bina out, by which the illumination of AB and Hochma was cut off from the ZON, for Bina cannot bestow Hochma to him after it came out of the head. Therefore the Yesod of the Mocha Stima'ah is discerned as the aspect of Daat, separating between AA and the ZON. However, at the time of the coupling, the screen of the Chochma Stima'ah descends from there to the aspect of the mouth, namely in the place of the chest of AA, and the HGT of AA rise and become his KHB, and the coupling of the palate and the throat of AA is made in the secret of the bowing of his head downward, and the mouth descends to the place of the former chest, and the Mazal VeNotzer is included in the palate of AA in the place of the former chest, and the Mazal VeNakeh is included in the throat of AA, which stands at the point of this chest. And then the Mochin of AB come out to Aba and Ima. Behold, that at the time of the return of the Bina of AA to his head, the Yesod of AA, together with the Mazalot, becomes the aspect of Daat for Aba and Ima, which is the Bina that returned to the head.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 97:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the river that comes out of Eden? The Bina that was included in the Hochma of AA at the time of their coming out in the place of the Reisha de Lo It Yeda, and afterward at the time of birth the Reisha de Lo It Yeda became clothed in the Malchut of the second restriction, through which the Chochma Stima'ah of AA was also corrected in the Nukva and took the Bina out to the aspect of the throat and the body. Behold, this Bina that is in the throat is discerned as a river that comes out of Eden, for Eden is the Mocha Stima'ah, and the Bina that was included in it comes out from it to the aspect of his body. However, this coming out of the Bina of AA is not felt in the GAR of Bina, namely from the chest of AA and above, where the upper Aba and Ima stand, but only from the chest and below, where YESHSUT stand, which are the aspect of the ZAT of Bina. For in the GAR of Bina, which are in the secret of "for He delights in mercy," there is no place for any screen and restriction to affect it, for the restriction was only on the aspect of Hochma and not on the aspect of Hassadim, as is known. But in the NHY of Aba and Ima, and likewise in YESHSUT, which are the aspect of the ZAT that need the illumination of Hochma, and cannot receive while they are in the aspect of a body, therefore the aspect of the diminution of the river that comes out of Eden rides upon them, and they alone are discerned as coming out of Eden and being diminished by the Nukva with which the Mocha Stima'ah was corrected, being lacking from the aspect of their attributed illumination. And this is the secret of the first He of the Name HaVaYaH, whose corner is the Yod, and the aspect of Israel Saba, which spreads here and there and becomes a Dalet. See below in Answer 98.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 98:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the river that spreads in its sides? YESHSUT, who clothe upon the NHY of Aba and Ima, are discerned as the aspect of a river that comes out of Eden, as in the adjacent answer. And they are also discerned as the aspect of a river that spreads in its sides, for there is the aspect of the coupling of the Yesodot of Aba and Ima. For the Yod, which is the aspect of Hochma and Israel Saba, spreads toward the side of above in the aspect of the Yesod of Ima, and spreads toward the side of below in the aspect of the Yesod of Aba, through which the illumination of Hochma is bestowed to the Vav that is within the He, which is the ZA in the pregnancy, standing there in these NHY of Aba and Ima. For they clothe the two shoulders of AA, where the NHY of Aba and Ima are included with ZA. As is known. And see above, Answer 65. (Item 61).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 99:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Netzitzu [spark]? See above, Answer 95.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 100:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the root point of Rachel? It is known that the roots of the ZON are in the ZAT of the Nekudim. And they have inner vessels and posterior vessels. For the aspect of the KHB HGT of their vessels up to the chest, which came out from the aspect of the looking of the eyes into the AHP, is discerned as inner vessels; and the aspect of the chest and below, which they attained at the time of greatness, by the power of the coupling of the Yesod of AK in the Aba and Ima of the Nekudim, is discerned as posterior vessels. It is also known that the breaking was only in the posterior vessels, because they had already come out to the aspect of BYA, by the Parsa of the second restriction, and were not fit to receive the light of Atzilut, and therefore they broke. This is unlike the vessels from the chest and above, which were in the aspect of Atzilut even from the aspect of the second restriction, and therefore they did not need to break; however, they too broke, and it is because of their joining and mixing with the posterior vessels. Therefore, when those inner vessels of the ZAT were corrected in Atzilut, and were separated from the posterior vessels once, no further matter of diminution and fall operates in them, for had they not mixed with the posterior vessels, they would not have broken even in the Nekudim, and now that they were separated from them, they already remain clean of any blemish, and became the aspect of Atzilut permanently. However, everything that was separated from the posterior vessels of these ZAT is only through the ascent of the MAN from the lower ones, and therefore their degree depends on the lower ones, and if the lower ones corrupt their deeds, they return and fall to BYA.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 101:1
items.html: (To the question) What are new souls? There are two aspects of new souls: one, those that are literally new, drawn from the Hochma of the direct light, and these do not come at all into the world of correction, in the secret of "the gardener who does not descend to his garden" from the time of the Nekudim and onward. And there is the aspect of the renewal of souls, which come from the aspect of the Hochma of the thirty-two paths, discerned as the aspect of the Bina that was included in Hochma, which is not literally new, for it was already included in Hochma, and understand. See above, Answer 16.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 102:1
items.html: (To the question) What are new souls of back to back? Explained above in the adjacent answer.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 103:1
items.html: (To the question) What are new souls of face to face? Explained above, Answer 101.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 104:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the path that is not known? The aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction is called the path that is not known, because no coupling operates upon it in Atzilut, from the Reisha de Lo It Yeda and below. And the aspect of the hairs of the beard is from this Malchut, and no Mochin of AB come out except upon this Malchut, included in the hairs of the beard, namely through the ascent of the GAR of AA to the Reisha de Lo It Yeda, and there this coupling is made, discerned as the path that is not known. (Item 53).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 105:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the upper Eden? The aspect of the Yesod in Beriah, which is Bina, is called the upper Eden. And the aspect of the Yesod in Assiyah, which is the aspect of Malchut, is called the lower Eden. (Item 86).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 106:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the lower Eden? See above, Answer 105.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 107:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the crown of Gevura? See Answers 14 and 90.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 108:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the crown of Hesed? See Answer 14.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 109:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the first and second pregnancies? The clarifications of the ZON of Atzilut are divided into two aspects: one, the clarifications of the aspect of the inner vessels, which are the aspect of the KHB HGT up to the chest, which came out in the smallness of the Nekudim, as above in Answer 100, see there. And these clarifications are called the first pregnancy, and this is the aspect of his permanence, as is said there. Two, the clarifications of the posterior vessels, which are from the aspect of the chest and below, which joined the ZA of the Nekudim at the time of greatness, and all these clarifications are discerned as the second pregnancy, which includes all the Mochin of ZA entirely. However, sometimes the Rav calls the aspect of the pregnancy that comes after two years of nursing, for the completion of his vessels, by the name second pregnancy. And the aspect of the ascent of the MAN for the need of the Mochin of birth, which is after nine years and one day, he calls by the name third pregnancy. (Item 7. And in the Inner Light there, s.v. "and this." And Item 2, and in the Inner Light there, s.v. "the pregnancy").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 110:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the third pregnancy? See Answer 109.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 111:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the world of concealment? Leah is called by the name the world of concealment. And it is because she stands in the place of the HGT, and is corrected in the posteriors of Ima, and she desires covered Hassadim and repels the illumination of Hochma.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 112:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the world of revelation? See above, Answer 111.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 113:1
items.html: (To the question) What is pleasure? Explained above, Item 19. (Item 63).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 114:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the essence of the upper one? Essence means Hochma, and the essence of the upper one indicates the Mocha Stima'ah, which was sealed in a membrane, not to be opened. And what the Mocha Stima'ah bestows below is from the aspect of the Hochma of the thirty-two paths, which it receives from the brain of the air, where the Daat of the Reisha de Lo It Yeda is clothed, and not from the aspect of its actual essence. (Item 95).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 115:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the essence of the upper one through clothing? The Mochin of the Hochma of the thirty-two paths, when they are in the place of their coming out in Aba and Ima, illuminate without the garment of the screens that are in the beard, since these screens serve in them from below upward, and the coarseness of the screens cannot diminish anything above its place of existence. However, when the Mochin are received by the ZON, they come to them in the clothing of the Yesodot of Aba and Ima, and then the essence of this upper Hochma is diminished in them, and it does not illuminate in them except to the measure of the screens, in the secret of the sun within its sheath. As was said above in Answer 14 at length, see there. (Item 95).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 116:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the essence of the upper one without a garment? This is the rule: after the head of the three of AA, the Hochma of AA does not illuminate from the aspect of its essence, but from the aspect of the Hochma through the MAN of the hairs, from which Aba and Ima receive. And Aba and Ima do not illuminate Hochma to the ZON except in the clothing of their Yesodot, through which the Tifferet, which is the five Hassadim, does not illuminate from the aspect of its essence, being the bearer of the illumination of Hochma, but it illuminates according to the measure of the crown of the Yesod, which is the aspect of the five Gevurot. As above in Answer 14. (Item 95).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 117:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the heels of Leah in the Keter of Rachel? The point of the chest of ZA is what ends the legs of Leah, because there ends the aspect of the covered Hassadim, which are the aspect of Leah. And that same point of the chest is also the Keter of Rachel, and it is found that the heels of Leah and the Keter of Rachel are from one aspect, and they are pressed lights. See above, Answer 5. (Item 23).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 118:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the foreskin that covers the Yesod? The aspect Dalet, upon which there is no coupling in a Partzuf of Atzilut, is called the foreskin, because the light distances itself from the place of its existence. Now, in Aba and Ima, which are the aspect Bet of the direct light, there is no existence of the foreskin, for the aspect Bet is far from the aspect Dalet. But ZA, who is the aspect Gimel of the direct light, in which the aspect Dalet begins after its end, therefore it is discerned that after the end of the Partzuf of ZA, namely after the crown of his Yesod, the aspect of the foreskin begins. However, this blemish cannot rise above the place of its existence, namely in ZA himself, but this blemish reaches the souls that are below the ZON, who need to receive from the crown of the Yesod of ZA, and they are found striking the foreskin that covers there below the Yesod, as above. Therefore the souls need special corrections, in order to remove from there the aspect of the foreskin. And they are the three years of the foreskin, for the Yesod includes the three lines NHY, and therefore there are three aspects there to purify them from the aspect of the foreskin. (Item 7).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 119:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the inner part of the Hochma in the secret of Daat? It is known that the principal bearer of this Hochma of the thirty-two paths is the Tifferet, namely ZA, which includes the five Hassadim. For Bina never returns to be Hochma except by the power of the Tifferet, which, with the joining of the crown of Gevura, is called Daat. Therefore the inner part of this Hochma is discerned as being seen from within the Daat, namely from within the Tifferet, which bears it also in the aspect of the Hochma of Bina herself, for both from the aspect of its drawing and revelation, and from the aspect of the standing and existence of the Mochin of Hochma with her, it is not supported except on the Tifferet, which is the Daat. (Item 87).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 120:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Righteous who is lost? In the days of the Temple, Aba and Ima were permanently in the stature of AB, and the ZON were in the degree of Aba and Ima, and the souls born of the ZON were in the aspect of face to face. However, after the destruction of the Temple, this great coupling disappeared from the aspect of permanence, and there is in permanence only the coupling for the life of the worlds, but the upper coupling ceased, and is not permanent. And upon that Yesod of greatness that disappeared from the aspect of permanence, it is said: "the Righteous is lost, etc." (Item 56).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 121:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Tzadik that comes out of her? The Yesod of the male is the aspect of the bearer of the Upper Light, called the direct light, and it is called the Tzadik that enters her, meaning the one that brings the Upper Light into the Nukva, and it is also called by the name Joseph. And the aspect of the screen in the Yesod of the Nukva, upon which the Upper Light strikes, since the screen pushes back and returns the Upper Light behind it, is discerned as the Tzadik that comes out of her, meaning that the Upper Light comes out and is pushed out from it, because it does not allow it to clothe within it; and with this strike it raises the returning light, which clothes and sustains the direct light, as is known. And it is also called by the name Benjamin. (Item 71).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 122:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Tzadik that enters her? It was explained above in the adjacent answer.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 123:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Zion? The Yesod of the Nukva, which is the aspect of the Tzadik that comes out of her, as above in Answer 121, is called by the name Zion. And it is from the language of going out, namely, named after the Tzadik that comes out of her. See there. (Item 70).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 124:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Tzelah [the side]? The aspect of the wall of the NHY of ZA, where there is the aspect of the Yesod of Aba, is called Tzelah. In the secret of the verse, "And the Lord God built the Tzelah" etc., and it is called the bride of Moses, for Moses is the Yesod of Aba, as is known. (Item 73).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 125:1
items.html: (To the question) What are existence and standing? There are two kinds of influx from Aba and Ima: one is from the aspect of giving life to the worlds, and it is also called the influx of existence and standing, and this influx comes from the aspect of the coupling that does not cease of Aba and Ima, namely, from Aba and Ima of the stature of SAG. And the second is the influx of blessing and the dainties of kings, namely, the Mochin of birth, and this influx comes from Aba and Ima of the stature of AB, whose coupling ceases and is not fixed, but only at the time that ZON rise to them as MAN, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 126:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the knot of the Tefillin of the head? The Mochin of the Nukva are not included in the six aspects of the Mochin of ZA, because the crown of Gevura, upon which the Mochin of Aba and Ima come out, was from the aspect of the Gevurot of the male, namely, from the aspect of Benjamin included in Joseph, and not from the aspect of the Gevurot of the Nukva, which is the aspect of Benjamin itself, as above in Answer 90. And the two first aspects of the Mochin of the Nukva come out in the head of ZA in a special coupling upon the Malchut of Ima, where the inner light comes out in the head of ZA in its internality, and the surrounding light comes out behind the head, in the nape, in the secret of the knot of the Tefillin. (Item 158).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 127:1
items.html: (To the question) What are Rachel and Leah? It is known that ZA in its entirety is built from the Mochin of Ima. And just as Ima, who is Bina, was divided into GAR and ZAT, whose GAR are the aspect of the upper Aba and Ima, which are covered Hassadim that reject Hochma, and whose ZAT are the aspect of Israel-Saba and Tevunah, which are revealed Hassadim in the illumination of Hochma; so ZA, which is built from Ima, is in the secret of "And I am a plain man": from the chest and above the aspect of the GAR of Ima illuminates in it, namely, the aspect of covered Hassadim, and from the chest and below the aspect of the ZAT of Bina illuminates in it, which are revealed Hassadim. And since they are almost two aspects opposite to one another, therefore the verse called him by the name "a plain man," and he is also called "helek" [part] because he is a part of the hairs, as is known.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 128:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the heads of the shoulders of AA? See Answer 14.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 129:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the firmament? The Yesod of ZA is called the firmament, because the Yesod is the end of ZA, which separates the aspect of the lights of the world of the male, so that they do not illuminate from it and onward; and therefore it is discerned as the firmament that separates between the upper waters, which are male, and the lower waters, which are female, for from it and below the world of the Nukva begins. And upon the screen in this Yesod, which separates the illumination of the male, a coupling of striking takes place there with the Upper Light, since it pushes back the Upper Light from spreading through it, and therefore it raises the returning light. (Item 79).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 130:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the upper firmament in the secret of Bina? See above, Answer 17.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 131:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the borrowing of the vessels of Rachel by Leah? Behold, at midnight, when the Mochin of Aba and Ima reached ZON from the illumination of the upper AB and SAG, which lower the bottom Hey from the eyes to the mouth, then the HGT of ZA become KHB, and the NHY of ZA become HGT, and new NHY, clarified from Beriah, come out to it. It is found that Leah, who used to end at the point of the chest in smallness, now ends at the place of the Yesod, for the NHY of ZA became HGT, and it is found that the point of the chest descended to the place of the crown of the Yesod of before, and with them the feet of Leah descended until the end of ZA. And then it is discerned that "Leah borrowed the vessels of Rachel," for these NHY are the place of Rachel, as above in Answer 127. And now Leah borrowed them, as above. And Rachel descended to Beriah, because her Keter, which is the point of the chest of before, now stands at the end of ZA. And it is discerned by the language of borrowing, because this is only for the moment, at night, in order to draw the aspect of vessels and spirit for the need of Rachel; however, in the morning Leah returns to her place and returns this place to Rachel. And therefore it is like the resemblance of a borrowing. And there is yet another reason in the matter, for this place of Rachel that Leah took did not remain in the aspect of Rachel, namely, in revealed Hassadim, but they came in the aspect of Leah to covered Hassadim, since they became HGT. And it is similar to one who borrows a thing from his fellow and makes in it his own use, and not the same use that his fellow, the lender, made in it. (Item 33. Part 1, Page 505, s.v. "and with this").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 132:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the borrowing of the vessels of Leah by Rachel? It was explained above, in the adjacent [answer], that at night after midnight, Leah borrows the vessels of Rachel to her own authority. However, by day, after the illumination of the vessels of Rachel has already been completed at night, behold, Rachel again ascends to Atzilut with the nine points of additions that were joined to her in Beriah, which are the new NHY, as above in Answer 131. And then the coupling face-to-face with ZA is made in his entire stature, and it is found that "Rachel then borrows the vessels of Leah," for then also from the chest and above of ZA the aspect of revealed Hassadim is made, and therefore Leah is pushed out from there to the aspect of the back of ZA, since it is against her nature and inclination, for she is always in the secret of "for He delights in mercy," like the GAR of Ima. However, this too is discerned by the name of a borrowing for the hour, because it does not operate except at the time of the coupling alone. But after the coupling she again returns this place to Leah, and Rachel descends below the chest. (Item 33. Part 1, Page 505, s.v. "and with this").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 133:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the narrow paths? The Yesod of Aba is called a path. And because the rule of the Yesod of Aba is revealed in the place of the NHY, which is narrow and long, therefore the illuminations of the NHY are called by the name of narrow paths, for they are lacking Hassadim from their own aspect, because the Yesod of Ima, which is the place of the Hassadim, has already ceased at the chest, and the Yesod of Aba, which illuminates there, is narrow of Hassadim; and all the aspect of the Hassadim in them descends to them from above, from the HGT, whose illuminations are discerned as wide roads, after the name of the Yesod of Bina, which bestows Hassadim there in breadth, according to its measure. And the Yesod of Bina, which is there, is called a road. (Item 96).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 134:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the root of Rachel and its principle? See above, Answer 100.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 135:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the rule of Malchut? The matter of the rule of Malchut is understood mainly as the completion of her vessels to ten [Sefirot], which are the main correction of the BAN, which is Malchut. For after she has ten vessels, behold, all the influx already reaches her from ZA, her husband, through the coupling of the day. However, the completion of the vessels of Rachel comes only at night, when the HGT of ZA rise and become KHB, and the NHY become HGT, and she acquires new NHY, which are clarified by Rachel at night in Beriah. And this rule of Rachel in Beriah is only at night, for by day she returns to Atzilut. (Item 5).

items.html: (To the question) What are the three foreskins? It was explained above in Answer 118.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 138:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the hairs, which are more material than the vapor of the mouth? The returning light that rises from the screen in the Malchut of the Galgalta of AA, which is the aspect Dalet of the clothing that is included with the aspect Gimel of coarseness in the Mocha Stima'ah, this returning light has no spreading at all below the head. And the reason is that this aspect Dalet, which is called the mouth, is completely pure from its own aspect, and all the aspect of the coarseness in it came to it from the aspect Gimel, which is the aspect of the vapor of the nose; and therefore the vapor of the mouth itself is hidden from the lower ones. However, the hairs are also an aspect Dalet like the mouth, but they are more material than the vapor of the mouth, because there is in them also from the aspect of the coarseness of the Malchut of the first restriction, since they do not serve except in the place of the Reisha de Lo It Yeda, as is known. And it is the secret of the Daat of the Reisha de Lo It Yeda, which is clothed in the air, from which the stature of the Hochma of the thirty-two paths is bestowed through the Mocha Stima'ah to Aba and Ima. And it is found that the main bestower is the Mocha Stima'ah, through the vapor of the nose, which is the aspect of the screen in the Yesod of the Mocha Stima'ah, for it receives from the hairs and descends to the place of Aba and Ima in the KHB of AA, and makes there a coupling upon the aspect of the Daat of the hairs, which are included in the screen of the Yesod of its aspect Gimel, which is called the nose; and in this manner it bestows the Mochin of AB to Aba and Ima, as above in Answers 78 and 79, concerning the matter of the bowing of the head. See there. And see Answers 32 and 33, concerning the matter of the vapor of the mouth and the nose. (Item 218).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 139:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the delights in MAN and MAD? At the time of the coupling, when the souls that are in the Nukva rise in her MAN and receive the aspect of their GAR through her GAR that causes delight, there is an aspect of delight to the ones coupling in the great completeness that the souls attained through the MAN and MAD of the coupling. As is said in the Zohar: "Go out and see, My son, in what I have come to you." (Item 63).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 140:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the delights in the souls? The Keter of Rachel, which descends at midnight to Beriah and connects to itself her nine [Sefirot], with which also connect the bodies and eyes of the souls of the righteous, who cleave to these nine; then the Holy One, blessed be He, who is the Keter of Rachel, delights with these souls over their emergence from within the shells and their connection in holiness. (Item 42).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 141:1
items.html: (To the question) What is an addition and not the principle? What is corrected in the Partzufim in a fixed manner is discerned as the principle of the Partzuf, and they are the six vessels HGT NHY of ZA, and the aspect of the Malchut of the Nukva, which is the crown of the Yesod of ZA. From the aspect of the vessels they are discerned as KHB HGT of ZA until the chest, and the aspect of the Keter of the Nukva, which is the point of the chest. And everything that ZON attain beyond these aspects, namely, the aspect of the NHY of the vessels of the Neshama, Chaya, Yechida of ZA, with the GAR of the lights; and likewise all the nine of the vessels of the NRNCHY of the Nukva, with the nine of the lights — all these are discerned as additions and are not the principle of the Partzuf, because they are not fixed in it, but depend on the good deeds of the lower ones. (Item 34).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 142:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the addition of power? From the aspect of the fixed Mochin of Aba and Ima and ZON, there is no power in them to give birth to souls. And in order that they have the power to give birth to souls, Aba and Ima need to receive an addition of power beyond their fixed measure, namely, they need to receive from AA the Mochin of AB — the GAR of the lights and the NHY of the vessels. And likewise ZON from Aba and Ima. And since they are not the principle of the Partzuf, therefore they are called the addition of power. (Item 13).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 143:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Tifferet in the aspect of being by itself? It is known that Daat is divided into Hesed and Gevura, which are called Tifferet and Yesod. It is also known that the main bearer of this Hochma of the thirty-two paths is the Tifferet, and therefore it is called by the name sun, being the root of all the lights that are revealed after AA, from the aspect of the Upper Essentiality, for the essentiality of AA is sealed in a membrane, and there is no revelation of essentiality from it and below, except through the Hochma of the thirty-two paths. And since the Tifferet is the main bearer of the illumination of this Hochma, therefore it is called by the name sun, meaning, just as the sun is the root of all the lights of this world, so ZA is the root of all the lights that are from AA. However, it is discerned in two aspects: one, when it is by itself, namely, outside the sheath of the screens in the crown of Gevura, when the aspect of its Hochma illuminates in complete revelation. And this does not operate except in the Mochin in the place of their emergence, namely, in the place of the GAR of AA, where Aba and Ima ascended at the time of the coupling. And there is a second aspect, that the Tifferet is clothed in the sheath of the crown of Gevura, and then the Tifferet is also called by the name crown, because it does not serve in its own measure but in the measure of the crown of the Yesod. And it is called by the name "the sun in its sheath," for all the Mochin of the six thousand years are from the aspect of the two crowns, which are the aspect of the sun in its sheath. However, in the future these Mochin will illuminate as they illuminate in the upper Aba and Ima in the place of their emergence, namely, that the Tifferet will illuminate from the aspect of being by itself, outside the sheath, as above. And on this the Sages hinted: "In the future the Holy One, blessed be He, will bring out the sun from its sheath," etc. (Item 81).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 144:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the dainties of kings? The Mochin that are revealed in the illumination of Hochma are called the dainties of kings, because the place of the revelation of the illumination of Hochma is in Malchut, which is the Nukva of ZA, as is known. (Item 62).
